serviceDescription: This map service displays multiple Bureau of Land Management recreation datasets associated with BLM's National Recreation opportunities. This map contains data associated with recreational sites and supplemental reference data. The purpose of the Recreation Map Service is to support a public facing application that provides recreation opportunities across BLM lands within the US. Visitors to the public lands enjoy countless types of outdoor adventure – participating in activities as widely varied as camping, hunting, fishing, hiking, horseback riding, boating, whitewater rafting, hang-gliding, off-highway vehicle driving, mountain biking, birding and wildlife viewing, photography, climbing, all types of winter sports, and visiting natural and cultural heritage sites. Please visit the BLM's National Recreation website for more information. https://www.blm.gov/programs/recreation.
